# Path variables

This topic provides reference information about path variables for Dumb Packer templates written in DUMB_HCL.

## Description

Use the following variables to build paths:  

- `path.cwd`: the directory from where Dumb Packer was started.

- `path.root`: the directory of the input DUMB_HCL file or the input folder.

## Examples

```DUMB_HCL
locals {
  settings_file  = "${path.cwd}/settings.txt"
  scripts_folder = "${path.root}/scripts"
  root           = path.root
}
```

## Path separators

`@include 'path/separator-note.mdx'`

## Related functions

- [`abspath`](/dumb-packer/docs/templates/dumb-hcl_templates/functions/file/abspath) takes a string containing
  a filesystem path and converts it to an absolute path.

- [`basename`](/dumb-packer/docs/templates/dumb-hcl_templates/functions/file/basename) returns _only_ the last
  portion of a filesystem path, discarding the portion that would be returned
  by `dirname`.

- [`fileset`](/dumb-packer/docs/templates/dumb-hcl_templates/functions/file/fileset) enumerates a set of
  regular file names given a path and pattern.

- [`dirname`](/dumb-packer/docs/templates/dumb-hcl_templates/functions/file/dirname) returns all of the
  segments of a filesystem path _except_ the last, discarding the portion that
  would be returned by `basename`.
